Name: Chore Trail
Author: xzqute
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/35MxSvt.png[/img][/center]
[center] [/center]
[center][url=https://smapi.io][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/SMAPI-4.1.0+-brightgreen.svg[/img][/url] [url=https://opensource.org/license/mit][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-lightgrey.svg[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/GMCM-Compatible-purple.svg[/img][/url] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Stardew%20Valley-1.6.14+-orange.svg[/img][/center]
[center][size=4]Select an area and automatically complete all chores inside it. [/size][/center]

[heading][size=5]Features[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Plan chores by area:[/b] Hold Space and drag over the part of the world you want to work on. ChoreTrail scans it and finds every task it knows how to do.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Real gameplay, not a shortcut:[/b] Your farmer still walks to each target, swings the right tool, and spends the same energy, water, and items a real turn would cost. Nothing about movement, animation, or item use gets skipped.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Visible plan:[/b] Action icons show what's about to happen before anything starts. The current target floats above the ground, and a trail - color and style are yours to set - marks the route.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Smart routing:[/b] Tasks queue up by how reachable they are, how far you'd have to walk, and how many tool switches it'd take. Hit an obstacle or change the map mid-route, and it replans, opening gates when it's allowed to.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Tool-aware selection:[/b] Stick to whatever's in your hand, or let ChoreTrail pull from every supported tool in your inventory.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Quick type selection:[/b] Space + double-click a target and every nearby task of the same type gets added too.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Rectangle and Paint modes:[/b] Draw a clean rectangle or paint a custom shape. Shift adds to the selection, Control subtracts from it.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Charged tools:[/b] Upgraded hoes and watering cans fire their charged patterns once you've selected the full footprint - Reaching enchantment included.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Safe placement planning:[/b] Chests, machines, sprinklers, scarecrows, workbenches, and tappers go down the way the game already places them, with route and escape checks layered on top.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Soft Takeover:[/b] Tap a movement key at any point and you're back in control immediately - the rest of the queue just waits for you.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Optional self-defense:[/b] Turn it on and ChoreTrail will pause a chore to swing your strongest carried melee weapon at monsters that wander into striking range. It won't chase them - it just holds the spot.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Plan panel:[/b] Check the queue, drop tasks you don't want, see what's done or skipped, and resolve anything ambiguous.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]GMCM support:[/b] Every setting is also available in-game through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]How It Works[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Hold [b]Space[/b] and drag with the [b]left mouse button[/b] to mark targets for normal tool use.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Use [b]Space + right mouse button[/b] for context actions and held-item actions such as harvesting, loading machines, planting, or placing equipment.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Release the mouse button to inspect the area and create a visible Chore Plan.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Review the action icons, then press [b]Space + Enter[/b] when confirmation is required.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Your farmer follows the route and carries out each verified task through the game's normal mechanics.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Supported Chores[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Crops and soil:[/b] Till valid ground, plant seeds, apply fertilizer, water crops, harvest mature crops, collect fruit, and cut scythe-harvest crops.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Farm cleanup:[/b] Break stones, ore nodes, twigs, resource clumps, and mine containers; chop mature trees; cut weeds, grass, and dead crops.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Foraging and exploration:[/b] Collect forage, dig artifact spots, use panning spots, and search available garbage cans.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Machines:[/b] Collect finished output and load compatible vanilla or data-driven equipment when the held item is accepted.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Crab pots:[/b] Collect ready catches and add compatible bait, following the game's own crab-pot rules.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Animals:[/b] Pet farm animals and pets, use milk pails or shears when required, fill pet bowls, and place hay in empty troughs.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Functional placement:[/b] Place held chests, data-driven equipment, sprinklers, scarecrows, workbenches, and supported tree tappers.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Controls[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Space + Left Mouse Drag[/b] - Mark targets for the held tool.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Space + Right Mouse Drag[/b] - Mark context and held-item targets.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Space + Middle Mouse[/b] - Switch between held-tool and inventory-tool targeting.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Shift / Control[/b] - Add to or subtract from the next selection.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Space + V[/b] - Switch between Rectangle and Paint selection.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Space + Double-click[/b] - Quickly select nearby tasks matching the clicked target.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Space + Enter[/b] - Confirm and start the visible plan.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Space + K[/b] - Open the plan panel.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Space + L[/b] - Lock or unlock the first previewed task type.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Space + P[/b] - Pause or resume the runner.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Space + Escape[/b] - Cancel a preview or skip the current target.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Space + Delete[/b] - Clear the current plan and selection.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Space + O[/b] - Show or hide ChoreTrail rendering.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Any movement key[/b] - Trigger Soft Takeover and keep the remaining queue.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]Gamepad controls are included and can be changed in GMCM. The default gamepad modifier is [b]Left Trigger[/b]. Standalone one-key shortcuts are disabled by default to avoid conflicts with ordinary gameplay controls.[/size]

[heading][size=5]Installation[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.0 or newer.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download ChoreTrail and extract the folder into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] directory.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Start the game through SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change every setting in-game.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Configuration[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Tool Target Mode[/b] - Use only the held tool or every enabled supported tool in the inventory. Default: Held tool.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Work Profile[/b] - Filter the plan to tool use, harvesting, collecting, clearing debris, soil preparation, watering, machines, animals, placement, context actions, or Smart behavior. Default: Use held tool.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Queue Ordering[/b] - Choose how tasks are prioritized. Default: Nearest reachable.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Auto-start Safe Plans[/b] - Start conflict-free, non-destructive plans as soon as selection ends. Default: Off.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Automatic Tool Selection[/b] - Let the runner select required tools. Default: Inventory only.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Auto-refill Watering Can[/b] - Route to a reachable native water source or well when the can is empty. Default: On.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Energy / Time Safety[/b] - Pause before the farmer reaches the configured energy or time limit. Defaults: 10 energy and 24:00.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Self-defense During Chores[/b] - Defend against monsters which enter the configured close range while a task is active. Default: Off.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Any Map Action[/b] - Include unknown map interactions such as doors, books, and gravestones. Default: Off.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Include Saplings When Chopping[/b] - Allow immature wild trees in automatic axe plans. Default: Off.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Visual Settings[/b] - Configure action icons, route visibility, opacity, spacing, passed markers, the lead marker, target levitation, HUD position, and custom icon sets.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or newer and SMAPI 4.1.0 or newer.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Built against Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Each installed instance only controls its own local farmer - no shared multiplayer queue or peer messages needed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Works automatically with compatible data-driven and probe-compatible vanilla or modded machines.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Uses public SMAPI and game APIs for gameplay. The only Harmony hook is a narrowly scoped renderer for ChoreTrail's own GMCM page labels.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Other mods can add their own capabilities and executors through the public ChoreTrail API.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Important Notes[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Plans stay inside one location and clear when you warp, by default.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Unknown custom objects are left alone unless they expose a supported game contract or register a ChoreTrail capability provider.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]ChoreTrail waits for NPCs and replans around them, but it doesn't try to predict their schedules.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Anything destructive or ambiguous waits for your confirmation by default.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]ChoreTrail is released and tested, but bugs still turn up sometimes. If you hit a reproducible one, report it in the Bugs section.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]
